name: go-page
requirements: Extend Handler(items []Item) http.Handler: optional kind filters by exact Kind; empty/missing kind selects all. Preserve input ordering and never mutate caller data.

Optional offset and limit are nonnegative decimal integers; missing offset=0, missing limit=unbounded. Invalid, empty, negative or overflowing numbers return HTTP 400. Filter BEFORE pagination; offset at/beyond end and limit=0 yield []. Successful results use application/json; unknown parameters are ignored; nil input yields []. Add focused handler tests.

allocation.A: Kind filtering in handler.go and focused tests.
allocation.B: Offset/limit pagination in the same handler.go and focused tests.

dependencies: Both subtasks edit Handler; selection order is filtering then offset then limit.

milestones.trigger: both agents have shared at least one nonempty unfinished diff
requirements: Integration observation: a red/blue interleaved input must be filtered before slicing; keep input order.
